Summary: Shot down in Laos on a string extraction.
REFNO Synopsis: The MIA file covers a string extraction of a recon team; one team member was not recovered.
War Story: The team hung below on ropes as we climbed out. The aircraft then dropped into the trees and exploded on impact. A second crew landed close by to help.
